verdict.rationale: Factory provides multiple concurrency mechanisms for engineering leads: parallel Droid sessions managed via API/App with isolated worktrees (factory-docs-13, factory-docs-23), multi-agent Missions for orchestrating large projects (factory-docs-11, factory-docs-16), droid exec for CI/CD batch/parallel scripting (factory-docs-6, factory-docs-17), and team-wide monitoring of active missions/worker progress plus per-developer usage metrics (factory-docs-27, factory-docs-28) which directly support scaling throughput across many concurrent agent tasks. Missing for 10: explicit documented concurrency limits/quotas per plan and independent/hands-on case studies validating throughput gains at scale.
